<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="23" x2="318" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="23" x2="323" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="23" x2="328" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="19" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="23" x2="347" y2="23" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="14" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="17" width="15" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="381" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,64 22,72 30,80" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="148" y="52" width="94" height="34" rx="8" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="195" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">LOGO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="140" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Reset password</text>
    <text x="24" y="170" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Create a new password to keep your account secure.</text>
    
    <!-- New password field -->
    <text x="24" y="211" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">New password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="220" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="217" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="250" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Enter new password</text>
    <ellipse cx="336" cy="244" rx="10" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="336" cy="244" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="253" x2="345" y2="235" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Confirm password field -->
    <text x="24" y="305" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="314" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="311" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="344" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Re-enter new password</text>
    <ellipse cx="336" cy="338" rx="10" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="336" cy="338" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="347" x2="345" y2="329" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Password guidance -->
    <rect x="20" y="389" width="344" height="58" rx="8" fill="#F5C418" opacity="0.10"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="414" r="9" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="40" y="418" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">i</text>
    <text x="58" y="411" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Use at least 8 characters with a mix</text>
    <text x="58" y="429" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">of letters, numbers, and symbols.</text>
    
    <!-- Buttons -->
    <g>
      <rect x="21" y="469" width="344" height="50" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
      <rect x="20" y="467" width="344" height="50" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
      <text x="192" y="498" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Continue</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="531" width="344" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="192" y="561" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Back</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Legal links -->
    <text x="195" y="618" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
    <text x="195" y="641" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Terms of Use  •  Privacy Policy</text>
    <line x1="126" y1="644" x2="180" y2="644" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="210" y1="644" x2="270" y2="644" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,797 49,789 59,797" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="42" y="796" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="49" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="145" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="151" y1="804" x2="157" y2="810" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="145" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Wishlist -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="240,792 244,796 248,792 253,794 253,805 244,811 235,805 235,794" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="244" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="337" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="806" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="337" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
